bullets.text: A grieving family in Thirumazhisai endured a 2.5-hour wait for cremation due to a crematorium power outage, and the office should monitor power backup issues there.
Vinoth Bharathi released a video disputing claims and asserting he provided a generator during the Thirumazhisai power failure, and the office should verify the generator claims.
Velachery floods persist despite 32.6 km of drainage infrastructure built from 47.5 crore rupees, and the office must investigate why drainage fails to stop flooding.
Passengers are stranded as electric trains bypassing St Thomas Mount fail to stop, and the office should coordinate with railway authorities to add stops.
Over 3,000 Avadi streetlights failed despite a 22-crore maintenance contract, and the office should penalize the contractor and fix the lights immediately.
A mother and son were arrested in Ambattur for sexually harassing two young girls, and the office should monitor the police investigation for swift justice.
Auto workers protested against the Vetri Payanam scheme, and the office should review their livelihood concerns regarding the proposed transport policy.
Vultr plans to build a 20 megawatt supercluster in Chennai, and the office should facilitate land and infrastructure clearances for the cloud firm.
Tata Communications is investing 4,000 crore rupees to build an AI-ready fibre network, and the office should track infrastructure development across data centres.
IIT Madras released a white paper stating AI will impact entry-level jobs in IT and banking, and the office should formulate skill development programs.
